description: Scans whose timestamp equals either boundary value are counted.

c.request: For scans taken between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (comparing the `chronotag` text), and only those linked to a site by site code, group by zone reference (`zoneref`) and site type (`typesite`). For each group, get the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) and the average of file size divided by scan duration (`gbsize` / `spanmin`), ignoring missing values. Then give me one row with two unrounded values: the average of the per-group compression-ratio averages and the average of the per-group size-per-minute averages. Scans whose timestamp equals either boundary value are counted.
c.sql: WITH zone_averages AS (SELECT s.zoneref, t.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_compression_ratio) AS avg_group_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS avg_group_size_per_minute FROM zone_averages;

d.request: Include scans whose `chronotag` text is between the two stated timestamps, inclusive, and whose `zoneref` matches a site code; group them by `zoneref` and `typesite`, calculate each group’s average `pressratio` and average `gbsize / spanmin` while ignoring missing values, then return one row containing the unrounded average of each set of group averages.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(group_pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(group_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, t.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS group_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS group_gb_per_min FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN :start_timestamp AND :end_timestamp GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.typesite) AS grouped_scans;

b.request: Include scans whose `chronotag` text is between the two stated timestamps, inclusive, and whose `zoneref` matches a site code; group by `zoneref` and `typesite`, calculate each group’s average `pressratio` and average `gbsize / spanmin` while ignoring missing values, then return one row containing the unrounded, equally weighted average of each set of group averages.
b.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT s.zoneref, t.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN :start_timestamp AND :end_timestamp GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio) AS average_group_pressratio, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS average_group_gb_per_min FROM site_groups;
b.raw: Include scans whose `chronotag` text is between the two stated timestamps, inclusive, and whose `zoneref` matches a site code; group by `zoneref` and `typesite`, calculate each group’s average `pressratio` and average `gbsize / spanmin` while ignoring missing values, then return one row containing the unrounded, equally weighted average of each set of group averages.

a.request: Take the scans whose timestamp (`chronotag`, compared as text) is from '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' through '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', with both endpoints included, and keep only scans that match a site by site code. Group them by scan zone reference (`zoneref`) and site type (`typesite`). For each group, work out the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) and the average of file size divided by scan duration (`gbsize` / `spanmin`), ignoring missing values. Then give me one row with two unrounded values: the average of those per-group compression-ratio averages and the average of the per-group size-per-minute averages.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg_pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(group_avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM (SELECT AVG(sc.pressratio) AS group_avg_pressratio, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS group_avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY sc.zoneref, si.typesite) AS grouped_scans;
